messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in this medicine.
There is a list of ingredients in this medicine, at the bottom of this page.
Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
If you become pregnant while taking this medicine, you should tell your doctor.
There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part.
Call 1-844-524-0039.
Visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has contact information", "visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound"]

The relation 'has contact information' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug provides specific contact details or resources for patients to reach out to, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
B. 'has formulation': The subject drug is available in the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
D. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
